question: Why is the arising of clear cognition unsurprising when overcome by the power of self-reflection?
premises: When something is overcome by the power of one's own reflective awareness, extraordinary cognition can arise.
The Spanda scripture states this for an attentive mind.
inference: The power of self-reflection naturally produces heightened cognition, as confirmed by the Spanda tradition.
plain_english: What wonder is it if this arises when overcome by the power of one's own reflective awareness? So it is said in the Spanda scripture, even in an attentive mind.
